__comment: NVisionX Scan Activity + OpenSearch Overview — ALL EKS CLIENTS, ONE DASHBOARD. Supersedes the loose hand-imported nx-scan-activity-all-clients.json (workspace root) — same uid, so once this git-synced copy lands it updates that dashboard in place instead of living as a second copy. EKS-only by design: the $client_ds picker only ever lists each client's own Prometheus datasource (Demo/Demo2/Integration/IONIS/KrispyKreme/SSB/UAT), which is how every EKS environment already reaches this central Grafana via remote_write; Replicated/on-prem clients use a completely separate deployment path (KOTS) and are intentionally not in this picker. Layout: top row = combined totals across every selected client. Below that, ONE COLLAPSIBLE ROW PER CLIENT (Grafana row-repeat on $client_ds) — expand a client's row to see, under that client's name: files scanned, data size, scans running now, backlog, a breakdown of WHAT TYPE of scans ran (by connector_type: S3/BOX/SHAREPOINT/etc), HOW MANY per source datasource, and a trend of scan volume + queue health over time. All per-client numbers come from OpenSearch indirectly: nx-scan-metrics-exporter (nx-application-helm's observability chart, component scanMetricsExporter) runs inside each EKS cluster, queries that cluster's OpenSearch domain directly (same VPC, no cross-VPC hop needed), and republishes nx_scan_files_total{connector_type}/nx_scan_bytes_total{connector_type}/nx_scan_files_by_datasource{datasource_access_id} as Prometheus gauges that ride the existing scrape->remote_write->mimir path. nats_consumer_* (Running/Backlog) comes straight from NATS's own exporter and needs no extra wiring. IMPORTANT PREREQUISITE: as of 2026-08-19 `scanMetricsExporter.enabled` defaults to false in nx-application-helm and no client's env-specific values file turns it on yet — until it's flipped to true and the observability layer is redeployed for a given client, that client's Files/Data/connector-type/datasource panels will read 0 while Running/Backlog (NATS-sourced) still show real numbers. That's a deploy-time toggle per client, not a dashboard bug.
